findings.body:
**Detect stop-propagation dependencies.**

At Line 99, `DEPENDENCY_RE` omits `PropagatesStopTo=`. If a co-installed `backup.service` sets `PropagatesStopTo=crq-tick.service` in `[Unit]`, discovery can report `supported=True` even though stopping the backup service also stops the selected service. Systemd v257 recognizes this directive and its inverse, `StopPropagatedFrom=`. Include both in the dependency scan. ([freedesktop.org](https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/257/systemd.unit.html))
findings.title: Detect stop-propagation dependencies.

findings.body:
**Use the XDG default for an empty configuration path.**

If `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` is set to an empty string, Line 1064 constructs the relative path `systemd/user`. `validate()` then refuses an otherwise valid host before composition. Use `$HOME/.config` when the variable is unset, empty, or relative. Continue to honor an absolute override. ([specifications.freedesktop.org](https://specifications.freedesktop.org/basedir/latest/))
findings.title: Use the XDG default for an empty configuration path.

findings.body:
**Unescape `%I` before checking the target unit.**

At Line 177, `%i` and `%I` both use the escaped instance text. In `ingress@crq\x2dtick.socket`, `Service=%I.service` resolves to `crq-tick.service` in systemd v257. The scan instead gets `crq\x2dtick.service` and drops the reference. Apply systemd's unit-name unescaping to `%I` only. Keep `%i` unchanged. ([freedesktop.org](https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/257/systemd.unit.html))
findings.title: Unescape `%I` before checking the target unit.

findings.body:
**Do not use the raw prefix to clear unresolved references.**

If `crq.socket` sets `Service=%p-tick.service`, systemd v257 expands that value to `crq-tick.service`. At Line 760, the unexpanded value lacks `crq-`, so discovery discards the reference. The socket name also falls outside the `crq-tick*` manager queries. Resolve `%p` from the source unit name. If a specifier remains unresolved, do not treat the reference as unrelated based only on its literal text. ([freedesktop.org](https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/257/systemd.unit.html))
findings.title: Do not use the raw prefix to clear unresolved references.

findings.body:
**Enforce the scan bound before collecting directory entries.**

Line 961 collects every child of an enablement directory and then sorts the list. Line 584 does the same for declared drop-ins. A directory with many more than `MAX_SCAN_ENTRIES` children incurs the full allocation and sort before the bounded dependency pass runs. Stop enumeration when the limit is exceeded. Sort only the entries that fit within the limit.







Also applies to: 961-961
findings.title: Enforce the scan bound before collecting directory entries.

findings.body:
**Report unscanned symlinked drop-in directories as incomplete.**

If `backup.service.d` points to a directory containing `[Unit] Wants=crq-tick.service`, systemd v257 resolves the directory and reads the drop-in. The top-level checks do not flag it because it belongs to `backup.service`. At Line 695, the dependency scan skips the directory target. Discovery can then return `complete=True` and `supported=True` without observing the dependency. Preserve the no-follow policy, but report an incomplete observation for a symlinked drop-in directory that systemd can traverse. ([raw.githubusercontent.com](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/systemd/systemd/v257/src/shared/dropin.c))
findings.title: Report unscanned symlinked drop-in directories as incomplete.
